info.title: Energy Brain API
info.description:
REST API of Energy Brain for the React dashboard (#27-#33). A deterministic optimiser makes every decision;
the LLM Explainer only explains the plan with numbers taken from tool outputs.

Response shapes are a contract: see `docs/api.md` and `docs/openapi.json` in the repository. Every plan says
whether it is safe to execute (`safe`) and whether a fallback forecast or signal was used (`banners`).
Backtest numbers come from `reports/backtest.json` and must be shown with their caveats.

get.description:
Version, which data/models/reports are present, whether an LLM key is configured (true/false only),
plan-cache statistics and the warm-up state.

The demo days of `config/demo_days.yaml` plus tomorrow (always a fallback forecast), with weekday,
workday/holiday flags, outage blocks and the forecast tier (predicted until the day has been planned).

post.summary: Plan a day at a cost/carbon weight
post.description:
Runs (or reads from the cache) the Forecast, Signal and Asset agents, the Planner and the Risk agent
for `date` at `w` rounded to 0.01. Unsafe or fallback plans are returned with 200 and flagged: check
`safe` and show `banners`.

post.summary: Ask the Explainer about a plan
post.description:
Answers with numbers traced to tool outputs only (`verified`, `provenance`), or a refusal. LLM problems
(no key, rate limit, network...) come back as 200 with `error` set and a clear `answer`. A stored verified
demo answer may be served instead (`cached: true`, see docs/api.md).

BatteryConstraints.title: BatteryConstraints
BatteryConstraints.description:
Battery limits. Charge/discharge kW are measured at the AC side.

Hard constraints: soc_min_kwh <= SoC <= soc_max_kwh in every slot; charge <= max_charge_kw;
discharge <= max_discharge_kw. SoC update (convention for the Planner):
``soc[t] = soc[t-1] + eta * charge[t] * h - discharge[t] * h / eta`` with ``eta = sqrt(rte)``,
``soc[-1] = initial_soc_kwh`` and ``h = slot_hours()``.

EvConstraints.title: EvConstraints
EvConstraints.description:
EV fleet charging, aggregated over all vehicles.

``plugged_in[t]`` True = vehicles parked and chargeable in slot t. ``charger_kw`` = total charger power
of the fleet. Hard constraints: ev_charge_kw = 0 when not plugged in; ev_charge_kw <= charger_kw; total
delivered energy >= ``energy_required_kwh`` by ``departure_slot`` (departure charge is never traded).
``arrival_slot`` / ``departure_slot`` are slot indices in [0, n_slots); the window may wrap midnight.

Forecast.title: Forecast
Forecast.description:
Forecast agent output (#14) for one planning day.

``solar``: PV AC output in kW. ``load``: INFLEXIBLE base load in kW, i.e. site demand EXCLUDING the
HVAC and EV charging that the Planner schedules. ``fallback_used`` is True when a persistence /
backup forecast replaced the model (PRD section 8); explain why in ``note``.

GeneratorConstraints.title: GeneratorConstraints
GeneratorConstraints.description:
Diesel generator. When running, min_kw <= generator_kw <= rated_kw; otherwise 0.

Fuel use = generator_kwh x fuel_l_per_kwh (cost and CO2 via the diesel signals).

GridConstraints.title: GridConstraints
GridConstraints.description: Grid connection limit. Export is not modelled (no net metering in the MVP).

llm_key_configured.description: an LLM key is set (the key itself is never returned)

HvacConstraints.title: HvacConstraints
HvacConstraints.description:
HVAC (the main shiftable load). ``occupied[t]`` True = workers on the floor in slot t.

Hard constraints: 0 <= hvac_kw <= rated_kw; hvac_kw >= min_kw_when_occupied whenever occupied; the
comfort band [comfort_min_c, comfort_max_c] is never traded for savings. Cooling may be shifted at most
``max_precool_hours`` earlier than needed.

PlanResponse.title: PlanResponse
PlanResponse.description: One plan plus the agent outputs behind it (what the dashboard charts need).

PlanResult.title: PlanResult
PlanResult.description:
Final output of one planning run (what the API and dashboard show).

``weight`` w in [0, 1]: the Planner minimises ``w * cost + (1 - w) * CO2``; 1 = cheapest, 0 = cleanest.
``reserve_margin_kwh`` is the battery reserve this plan was solved with.

QuantileSeries.title: QuantileSeries
QuantileSeries.description: P10/P50/P90 power forecast in kW per slot. Requires 0 <= p10 <= p50 <= p90 in every slot.

RiskReport.title: RiskReport
RiskReport.description:
Risk agent output (#18).

``ok`` False = plan fails under the stress scenario (default P10 solar / P50 load; a P90-load replay is
advisory only) or is unsafe; ``reasons`` say why, one stable line each (see ``risk.parse_reason``).
``reserve_margin_kwh`` = battery reserve the Risk agent asks the Planner to keep on the next re-plan.
``replans`` = number of re-plans the orchestrator ran before this report (filled by the orchestrator).

Schedule.title: Schedule
Schedule.description:
Planner output: power flows per slot, all in kW (averaged over the slot) and >= 0.

Energy balance (must hold in every slot)::

    solar_used + grid_import + battery_discharge + generator
        == base_load + hvac + ev_charge + battery_charge

``solar_used + solar_curtailed`` = available solar. ``battery_soc_kwh[t]`` is the SoC at the END of
slot t (see ``BatteryConstraints`` for the update rule). ``base_load_kw`` is the inflexible load the
plan was built for (normally the Forecast load P50).

SignalTable.title: SignalTable
SignalTable.description:
Signal agent output (#15): prices, emission factors and outages per slot.

``outage[t]`` is True when the grid is UNAVAILABLE in slot t (load-shedding): grid import must be 0.

Totals.title: Totals
Totals.description: Day totals and per-slot cost/CO2. Always produced by ``energy_brain.accounting.compute_totals``.
